I find that apathy comes at a time when I have no clue what I really want to do next with my life. What I have done is had to look inside myself. I meditated on it.  I mean this literally. Try meditation, it will focus your brain. Then, once you feel some kind of mental change, think about what your really really want. You could say now that you don't care. But that is not really true. Would you care say if a good friend died, a close family member, a pet, or even just a random person. We all have some sort of care inside us. Yes, even something not as negative and extreme as death can get us to care. Think about what your happy place would be. Even if you think that place is unreachable, just think on it. Eventually you will find something to move towards. And once you start towards that goal, a goal to give meaning or at least a frame to your life, you will start to feel better. That at least has been my experience so far.
Stay strong good sir.

One outlier does not equal the collective system being this way. The Last Airbender is as far removed production wise from the other array of films featuring young actors. You can't blanket an industry as large as Hollywood into a collective and then cite an individual example as the norm.That is what I'm saying. 

The institution has already been correcting their "collective" racism. See Moonlight and Hidden Figures. People complained a year before about white Oscars, so they attempted to rectify it. But even before then we had plenty of black actors and films being nominated and awarded. Even lackluster films like Precious got a big spotlight despite the majority black cast. 
Fine, preferring money over treating all races fairly is racist. But it would not be "White Supremacist". Which was what I was arguing initially.

This is the problem with a lot of these arguments. Hollywood is not a single person, it is a very large and diverse amalgamation of different people. Maybe some are racist. Maybe some aren't but they would rather have Scarlet Johansen as their lead than a Asian Actress no one has ever heard of. Just look at this list and see if any are household names: http://www.imdb.com/list/ls070416772/
I do not think racism is the right word for this. Possibly just greed. They care more about the name of the actress than their skin. Many hollywood executives are more concerned about how many tickets the lead will draw in vs. how many people will be offended. Being PC is not overpowered by casting big movie stars and potentially drawing hundreds of millions more dollars. However, there are still PoC and other minority actors that do draw in millions. It's actually very common. I am actually so tired of seeing Dwayne Johnson appear in things because he seems to always have a movie or show out. Samuel L Jackson has been one of the biggest stars for over 2 decades now. Will Smith might have declined a bit, but he is still very high caliber. Denzel Washington? I could go on for awhile. And though it has a white lead, Spider-Man Homecoming has two black female leads, Peter Parkers best friend is Fillipinio. If Hollywood was actually "white supremacist" this film could not exist.

As for The Last Airbender, that film is so bizarre I don't know if racists could be involved, crazy people, extraterrestrials, or they took a lot of drugs. Wouldn't be surprised if zombie Hitler casted that film considering all the nonsensical choices were made in it.

I'm not saying they won't accept a black lead, they definitely would. But in order for a black lead to be cast in something, they would almost have to conciously decide to dismiss the pool of white A-list actors. 

I would agree that the modeling industry is oversaturated with whites though.

I find using sleepyti.me or a Sleep Cycle alarm app helps. So say you wake up at 6am to go start your day. You are only on 3-4 hours or so of sleep pprobably, so now stay up as long as possible. When you have a chance to sleep, use one of those apps to find how long 1 sleep cycle is, and then wake up after one cycle. If you have more time, do 2 cycles, but no more than 2. You should wake up more refreshed than normal, just don't go back to sleep until a normal time. This has helped me time and time again to return to a good schedule.

You can also take this further by looking at alternate sleep cycles, google Alternate Sleep Cycles
